name: Spaceship 573a43ed on the 3-uniform tiling k3-032
description: A period-3 spaceship on the 3-uniform tiling k3-032 (touching neighbours), 10 to 13 cells, moving one lattice step every 3 generations (c/3). It runs the same way in the 1,024 rules from B3/S3457 to B3,7,8,9,10,11,12/S3,4,5,7,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 2 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
